Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: clean first-frame plate for a 5-second animal tracking video, landscape 16:9, intended final size 1600 × 900
Primary request: A moon jellyfish drifting naturally in a dark coastal rock pool at night.
Scene/backdrop: near-black natural rock-pool habitat; kelp and a barnacled rock edge occupy the lower third; at least 40% of the entire frame is near-black open water or shadow.
Subject: one anatomically correct moon jellyfish, bell visibly in a natural pulse shape, delicate tentacles trailing through the water; animal tack-sharp and clearly readable.
Style/medium: photographic underwater macro realism, natural rather than stylized, in the same austere dark visual world as a nocturnal wildlife study.
Composition/framing: moon jellyfish placed left of centre, with generous clean near-black room on the right for a later data twin; habitat remains visible in the lower third.
Lighting/mood: exactly one low torch-like light source from the side; restrained gold and white highlights, with the jellyfish’s own subtle translucent colour allowed; deep nocturnal contrast.
Materials/textures: believable translucent bell tissue, fine tentacles, wet barnacles, kelp, rock texture; tiny suspended particles catch the single side light.
Constraints: anatomy correct; only animal and natural habitat; at least 40% near-black; animal sharp; no additional jellyfish.
Avoid: any HUD, text, letters, numbers, symbols, captions, logos, watermark, frames, borders, graphic lines, tracking marks, diagrams, interface elements, synthetic neon styling, illustration, fantasy anatomy, multiple light sources.

Subject: one anatomically correct compass jellyfish, left of centre, with a distinct natural patterned bell and very long, fine, individually legible trailing tentacles; animal tack-sharp and clearly trackable.
Style/medium: photographic underwater macro realism, natural and biologically plausible, austere nocturnal wildlife study.
Composition/framing: close and low camera angle; jellyfish left of centre; long fine tentacles remain within the landscape frame; uncluttered open black water around it.
Lighting/mood: a single low side light; restrained gold and white highlights plus the jellyfish’s own amber-brown translucent colour; dim bioluminescent plankton as tiny isolated sparks, not a graphic effect.
Materials/textures: translucent wet bell tissue, delicate natural tentacles, faint suspended particles, believable seagrass texture.
Constraints: anatomy correct; only animal and natural habitat; exactly one jellyfish; at least 40% near-black; animal sharp.
Avoid: any HUD, text, letters, numbers, symbols, captions, logos, watermark, frames, borders, graphic lines, tracking marks, diagrams, interface elements, synthetic neon styling, illustration, fantasy anatomy, duplicate bells, tangled or fused anatomy, multiple light sources.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: clean first-frame plate for a 5-second multi-target animal tracking video, landscape 16:9, intended final size 1600 × 900
Primary request: A small cluster of exactly three comb jellies (ctenophores) suspended in black seawater beside one natural frond of seaweed.
Scene/backdrop: near-black open water; a single seaweed frond provides sparse habitat context; at least 40% of the entire frame is near-black.
Subject: exactly three anatomically plausible comb jellies, each a complete separate individual with clear black-water separation between silhouettes so a tracker can follow three targets; their longitudinal iridescent comb rows are visible as subtle spectral highlights; all three animals sharp.
Style/medium: photographic underwater macro realism, natural and biologically plausible, austere nocturnal wildlife study.
Composition/framing: balanced cluster across the central-left area, three distinct non-overlapping bodies at slightly different depths but all in crisp focus; seaweed frond adjacent rather than obscuring them; uncluttered negative space remains.
Lighting/mood: exactly one low side light; restrained gold and white highlights with the ctenophores’ natural faint rainbow iridescence allowed; deep black water and subdued nocturnal contrast.
Materials/textures: glasslike transparent gelatinous tissue, fine realistic comb rows, natural seaweed texture, sparse suspended particles.
Constraints: exactly three separate trackable ctenophores; anatomy plausible; only animals and natural habitat; at least 40% near-black; all animals sharp.
Avoid: any HUD, text, letters, numbers, symbols, captions, logos, watermark, frames, borders, graphic lines, tracking marks, diagrams, interface elements, synthetic neon glow, illustration, fantasy anatomy, overlapping or fused bodies, more or fewer than three animals, multiple light sources.
